known_answer.what_is_absent: no solved NR-V04 ternary structure; no paralogue-resolved K_d, alpha or dG_coop
known_answer.therefore: the holdout can test DIRECTIONAL CONCORDANCE with a functional ordering only — never recovery of a measured quantity

measured_confound.finding: NR4A1 Cys551 is NOT conserved: NR4A2 aligned position = Tyr, NR4A3 = Thr, no Cys within +/-5 in either
measured_confound.consequence: celastrol cannot form the covalent adduct on NR4A2/NR4A3 at all, so NR-V04 paralogue selectivity is at least partly warhead reactivity
measured_confound.design_response: the panel DECOMPOSES rather than reproduces: R1 holds covalency OFF across all three paralogues; R2 isolates the covalency component on NR4A1
measured_confound.forbidden: no covalent NR4A2/NR4A3 leg may ever be added — there is no cysteine to bond to

protocol.source_of_truth: md_settings.py (canonical) — identical to the covalent feasibility panel, so its legs remain a cross-check
protocol.deviation_rule: any deviation on any single leg VOIDS THAT LEG, never the threshold

E1_PRIMARY.quantity: interface-RMSD plateau (A) — mean interface heavy-atom RMSD over the final 50% of production frames vs the starting interface
E1_PRIMARY.role: the ONLY endpoint the verdict turns on

E2.role: secondary; the readout that discriminated in the feasibility panel

E3.role: secondary; KNOWN weak discriminator — reported, never gating

endpoints.reporting_rule: E2-E4 are reported alongside E1 in every result, including when they disagree with it

statistics.unit_of_independence: the CO-FOLD MODEL (2 MD replicas of one model are not independent) -> model-level means, n = 3 per arm

primary_test.statistic: mean(E1 | retro_noncov_nr4a1) - mean(E1 | retro_noncov_nr4a2 U retro_noncov_nr4a3)
primary_test.method: exact one-sided permutation, exhaustive enumeration of C(9,3) = 84 arrangements
primary_test.predicted_sign: negative (NR4A1 more stable) — REGISTERED BEFORE DATA

secondary_tests.pairwise: NR4A1 vs each paralogue, exact permutation over C(6,3) = 20
secondary_tests.pairwise_limitation: minimum attainable one-sided p is 0.05, reachable only under perfect separation — descriptive support, never the verdict
secondary_tests.leave_one_model_out: sign of the primary statistic recomputed with each of the 9 models dropped; 'survives' = sign unchanged in all 9 refits
secondary_tests.covalency_decomposition: mean(E1 | retro_cov_nr4a1) - mean(E1 | retro_noncov_nr4a1); reported with no significance claim at n=3 vs 3

extension_rule.action: generate 3 additional co-fold models per paralogue, re-run R1 at n = 6 models/arm (C(18,6) = 18564)
extension_rule.restriction: the ONLY pre-authorized extension; may NOT be invoked on a wrong-sign result
extension_rule._superseded_window: (0.012, 0.05] — retired by AMENDMENT 3 defect 2 (2026-07-25): attainable p is k/84, so that window held only {0.0238, 0.0357, 0.0476}, all <= alpha and therefore already CONCORDANT, while the smallest attainable p above alpha (0.0595) sat outside it. The rule could never fire in the case its own text names. Code home: nrv04_retro_gate.EXTENSION_P_WINDOW.

technical_failure.rerun: a NaN/blow-up leg is re-run ONCE from a fresh velocity seed
technical_failure.arm_threshold: more than 1 failed leg in an arm -> that arm is underpowered -> verdict INDETERMINATE

statistics.no_interim_analysis: the paralogue contrast is computed ONCE, after all R1+R2 legs land. Per-leg liveness/convergence monitoring is required; looking at the arm ordering before the panel completes is not permitted.

verdict_tiers.CONCORDANT: d < 0 AND p <= 0.05 AND NR4A1 mean below BOTH paralogue means AND no arm underpowered
verdict_tiers.WEAKLY_CONCORDANT: d < 0 and NR4A1 below both, but p > 0.05
verdict_tiers.DISCORDANT: d >= 0, or a paralogue is below NR4A1 with p <= 0.05 in the reverse direction
verdict_tiers.INDETERMINATE: any arm underpowered, or a protocol deviation voided legs
verdict_tiers.leave_one_model_out: REPORTED robustness diagnostic — computed and emitted on every verdict, but NOT part of any tier's conjunction (AMENDMENT 3 defect 3, 2026-07-25)
verdict_tiers._superseded_conjunction: CONCORDANT previously also required 'sign survives leave-one-model-out', and WEAKLY_CONCORDANT previously also fired on 'or the sign fails leave-one-model-out'. Retired by AMENDMENT 3 defect 3: an adversarial search found 228,543 configurations reaching p <= alpha with the correct ordering and ZERO of them failed LOMO, so the clause could never be false when the others held and the LOMO-predicated WEAKLY_CONCORDANT branch was unreachable code. The CONCORDANT set is UNCHANGED by construction. Code home: nrv04_retro_gate.verdict.

honest_failure_semantics.discordance_does_not_falsify: NR-V04 selectivity may arise from the covalent warhead chemistry alone (Leg 0 shows this is SUFFICIENT, since the paralogues lack the cysteine entirely) or downstream at ubiquitination
honest_failure_semantics.discordance_does_mean: the ensemble ternary workflow has NOT demonstrated NR4A paralogue discrimination on this holdout and may not be cited as authority for a prospective selectivity claim; that authority then rests solely on valB's public paralogue-discrimination module, and the manuscript must say so
honest_failure_semantics.the_expected_null: a null R1 with a strong R2 covalency effect is a coherent, publishable answer that localises NR-V04 selectivity to warhead reactivity — registered in advance so it cannot later be re-narrated as a method failure or quietly dropped

claim_ceiling.permitted: Run identically across NR4A1/2/3 without tuning, the ensemble ternary workflow was directionally concordant/discordant with the reported NR-V04 outcome.
forbidden: any ddG / alpha / cooperativity / affinity claim (Arm E computes no free energy)
claim_ceiling.standing_caveat: the NR-V04 chemistry in-repo is an NR-V04-inspired representative reconstruction, not a verified exact structural match (nrv04-ternary-benchmark.json chemical_identity.blocker)
